text: The Lake Thresher is a threshadon that can be found in the eastern portion of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains.

Lake Elrendar is located in southeastern Eversong Woods and crosses into the Ghostlands. The large Elrendar River flows out of Lake Elrendar. The lake also has a small island with a cave that is involved in a paladin quest. Many people drowned in the southern-most part of the lake, and it is now haunted by wraiths of the past. The Farstriders readily accept the aid of those willing to hunt the undead.

"There are rumors - some sinister, some benign - that Landro's influence extends beyond the arena of gambling." Landro Longshot is a goblin TCG item redeemer located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. After the Fourth War, Landro met with Mathias Shaw and Flynn Fairwind.

:This article is about the in-game raid boss. For her character biography, see Vashj. Lady Vashj is the final boss of Serpentshrine Cavern in Coilfang Reservoir. Phase 2 is a Battle for survival which tests the raids capability to function as a team, while phase 3 is a rather straightforward DPS race.
Lantresor's Warblade is a polearm. It gives bonuses to strength and agility. This is Lantresor of the Blade's weapon.
Due to the amount of information written for Lands of Mystery and the inability for it to all be placed in the books, much of the extra material was released as a free web bonus.

Laius is an archmage, who wanted to study a certain collection of ancient troll artifacts that supposedly existed in the days of the troll empire. He believed they could be found in the Zuldazar vaults. He learned that the Alliance had disguised a group of adventurers as jungle trolls with magic items; who were being sent to Zuldazar in order to spy on one of the troll's 6-year gatherings to learn about the troll's plans, and determine if the trolls could become allies. Before they headed out on the mission, he took the heroes aside and asked them if they could check the vaults for the scrolls. If the items were lying in the vaults, he wanted to study them.

Lambent Eye of Zul is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting. It requires a minimum skill of 450 and a Simple Grinder. ; Materials required: :1x Eye of Zul The recipe taught by Design: Lambent Eye of Zul, sold by Timothy Jones in Dalaran, and Inessera in Shattrath City for 4 Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Tokens.

Lands of Azeroth seems to be have been a book that was canceled and later split into Lands of Conflict and/or Lands of Mystery. It was to have been released in April of 2004, the 5th book in the series, after Dungeons & Dragons Warcraft The Roleplaying Game, Manual of Monsters, Alliance & Horde Compendium, and Magic & Mayhem. It is advertised at the end of the book Warcraft: The Roleplaying Game. :"Travel beyond the wastelands of Southern Kalimdor; visit the ghost haunted-remnants of the human nation of Lordaeron; journey to the Ironforge dwarves' thriving homeland; take the war to the enemy in Northrend; explore the wonders and horrors beneath the Maelstrom. This campign setting sorucebook
Lake Edunel is a small lake found on the western side of the Verdant Thicket. Mountain Trout can be fished up here.

Lao & Son's Yakwash is the business of Lao Muskpaw and Muskpaw Jr. after the yaungol of the Burilgi tribe have taken and destroyed Muskpaw Ranch, just to the west. Yaks cleaned here are sold to the grummles of the Grummle Bazaar, to the northwest. Just south, across the Autumn Plains, is the entrance to Pranksters' Hollow.

Lao Lang is a representative of the Shado-Pan sent to the Shrine of Seven Stars to enlist Alliance aid. He can be found on the lower level of the Summer Terrace. He will only offer his quest to those who have reached status with the Golden Lotus.

The Lake of Stars lies south of the southern fork of the Horrid March leading to Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds, just west of the southern end of the Serpent's Spine. A saurok tribe and crocolisks are fighting for control of the lake—the saurok mostly control the south end of the lake, while the crocolisks have claimed the north. Just west of the lake is Kypari Zar. South of the lake is the Chittering Coast.
__NOTOC__ Lakaan is a Broken located at the Coilskar Point in Shadowmoon Valley. He holds a medallion fragment.
Lakaan's Medallion Fragment drops from Lakaan in Shadowmoon Valley for the quest The Ashtongue Corruptors.
Lali the Assistant is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

This currently sit's at 1,555,161 views and is in the "hall of fame' to the Warcraft community. As for Lag Spike Films themselves, their origins are by a guy named Steve. __NOTOC__ Laeni Silvershot is a blood elf quest giver and a member of Hemet's Hunting Party found at Nesingwary's Retreat in Highmountain. She sends adventurers to hunt down the cursed moose spirit, Morashu, and later participates in the fight against Irewing at her nest in Pinerock Basin.
Lady Wolfsheim is a Forsaken attending Mistress Matilda's party on the terrace above the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.

Laraelor the Enlightened was a nightborne located in Suramar City. He hoped to augment the nightborne constructs by studying the properties of Lumenstone, but was killed by the Conclave to obtain the Lumenstones.

The Lady in White is a ghostly being featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. Gilneas is a haunted city. Many of its ghosts are here to help. In life, the Lady in White was a Gilnean noble woman, who saw the destruction of almost all that she loved during the fall of Gilneas. As a ghost, she seeks to help the living restore all that was lost. While the activity of restless spirits has increased sharply since the arrival of the curse in the Witchwood, most seem to be petty, malignant things, content to rage against the living. Not so with the Lady in White, who has become a symbol of hope and reassurance to the citizens of Gilneas in this dark time. She tends to appear only to
Lakeshire Guards are humans located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Max-level versions appear when approached by the Horde.
__NOTOC__ Laphandrus Voidheart is a gnome warlock trainer located at the Training Hall in Stormwind City.

Lakali is the loa of knowledge, whose soul slumbers inside a wildseed at Tirna Scithe. The gorm matriarch Tred'ova tried to consume Lakali's power and wisdom, increasing her own intelligence in the process, until she was killed by Maw Walkers. Afterward, Droman Oulfarran stated that Lakali's soul was still intact and would heal with time. One of the items Tred'ova drops is called Lakali's Spire of Knowledge.
Lanra is a sylvar flight master located at Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald.
Languishing Soul Detritus is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Lang Family Wood-Carving can be picked up at the Phasing Korthian Shrine on the westernmost floating island off the edge of Korthia. At (revered) with the Archivists' Codex, purchase and use the Research Report: Ancient Shrines, then interact with the shrine, reach the altar, start the quest Lang Family Wood-Carving, then get back to safety before time on the buff runs out.

__NOTOC__ Lapisagos is a blue dragon located in the War Creche in the Forbidden Reach. He and others of the blue dragonflight were charged by Malygos to stand guard over the imprisoned dracthyr and keep that a secret. He considers the dracthyr failed experiment.
The Lair of the Devout is a cave accessed from Feltotem in western Highmountain. Tehd Shoemaker and Marius Felbane are fighting Kuglaroth.

The Laughing Skull clan (or simply the Skulls) was an orc clan that dwelled in southeastern Gorgrond and on the island of Farahlon. Maniacal and bloodthirsty, the Laughing Skulls were considered to be mad by other clans, and they later had a reputation for treachery and deceit.
Lash of Pain is an ability of the Sayaad, a warlock minion. It is an instant-cast attack that deals Shadow damage

__NOTOC__ The Laughing Sisters are dryads protecting Ordanus together with Cenarion Protectors and Blink Dragons near Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale. Apparently their hair holds magical properties as it is used in fashioning Nether-lace Garment. Their dead bodies can be found littered around the battleground at Raynewood Retreat.

__NOTOC__ Last Stand is a level 32 Protection warrior ability. When used, it temporarily adds 30% of the warrior's maximum health for 15 seconds. At the end of the duration, these hit points are removed.
__NOTOC__ Larimaine Purdue is a human portal trainer located in the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City.

__NOTOC__ Latosius was one of the senior members of the Moon Guard when the War of the Ancients began. An elderly night elf, he had practiced sorcery for a very long time, and he considered himself one of the foremost spellcasters of his order.

The Launch Bay (sometimes referred to the Hangar) is located within Gnomeregan, and lies beyond the tunnels leading from the Hall of Gears. It has one upper level and one lower level, both of which hold leper gnomes and their mechanical contraptions. The can be found on the central platform accessible via a ramp from the west side of the upper level. Several flying machines and bombers are still there. The Launch Bay upper level has two doorways: the eastern one is the aforementioned tunnel from the Hall of Gears; the southeastern leads down ramps to the lower level, where continuing straight (then left) will lead to the Engineering Labs' upper level, and turning right (northwest) will lead
Larson Clothiers is a robe and hat shop located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.

Larisse Pembraux is an heirloom vendor found inside the Command Center of Old Town in Stormwind City. She offers heirlooms to players with too many Justice Points to spend. Her vendor list can be found on the Justice Points article.
Lash is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Laser is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Launch is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Launch Rocket is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Lastrea Greengale is a night elf flight master located at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

Large Daddy is a robot located at the Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains. Clarissa runs around the machine, hoping it will get fixed so that they can go on a killing spree and get ice cream. After recovering its parts, it can be used during Mr. D's Wild Ride. Its Alliance counterpart is Big Papa.

Lasers and Magnets and Drills! Oh My! is a dungeons & raids achievement earned for defeating Siegecrafter Blackfuse in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance without destroying each of the listed weapons.

The Laughing Skull Orcs, or Laughing Skull clan, is an orc clan presumably led by Kaz the Shrieker and makes their home in Gorgrond. Known for their violent and bloodthirsty nature, these orcs take great pride in their clan identity and have therefore refused to join the Iron Horde. With the Iron Horde trying to destroy the Laughing Skull clan, they have allied themselves with the Frostwolf clan and the Horde to fight their common enemy. In the past, the two clans battled against each other. Following events in Gorgrond, however, they appear to be rather close allies. Early in their settlement of Draenor, the draenei Rangari learned from the Laughing Skulls that podlings hate fire. The Ranga

__NOTOC__ Larthogg is a mo'arg brute that appears at the Highmountain Burial Ground during a Legion Assault. He previously appeared at Darrow Hill in the Hillsbrad Foothills and in Azshara during the Legion Invasions.
Last Call is an Extra Action Button ability that becomes available when Tipsi Wobblerune and Anebria Sunwine decide to travel to the next inn.
The Large Charm of Strength dropped from The Cow King during the Diablo's 20th Anniversary event or the Treasure Goblins from the anniversary event and A Greedy Emissary event.

Large Plundered Sack is a large bag object located in the Hall of Shadows near Marin Noggenfogger. It can only be seen if you have researched the class hall trait The Vault and have either completed A Ticket for Marin or handed over Marin Noggenfogger's Lucky Coin to Marin. Its availability depends on the day's rotation of rewards.
Larry the Linesman is a Mechagon mechagnome located at the Outflow on Mechagon Island. He manages the Reclamation Rig.
Lasher Vines are part of the lashers located at the Outflow and Broken Point on Mechagon Island.
Lastwind Bracers are a quest reward from Shattered and Broken.
Last Year's Brewfest Flyers are looted from Blingtron 7000 Gift Package.
Latch-and-Lock Triggers have a chance to drop from mobs on Mechagon Island during Ideas Can Come from Anywhere.
The Last Vestige of Neltharion drops from N'Zoth the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Lashing Scars is a conduit for rogues. It drops from the following bosses: *The Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).
Latent Poison Injectors is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Poisonous Injectors.
Last Emperor's Capacitor is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Last Emperor.
The Large Nest is found in the Hidden Grove in Winterspring. The nest can be destroyed in order to coax out Snowblind.
Lava Cores are internal cores of a very powerful, flame-based elemental. Used in numerous high-level craftable items often paired with Fiery Cores.

__NOTOC__ Laurna Morninglight is a night elf priest trainer located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Laurna did not survive Burning of Teldrassil as she is a wisp located within the Terrace of the Moon in Bel'Ameth and is accompanied by Irlara Morninglight.
Lavawalker Greaves are a pair of Level 48 quality Plate Boots that improve Strength, Stamina and Haste.
Lavacrest Leggings are a pair of Level 47 quality Plate Leggings that improve Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.

Leader of the Pack is a passive specialization ability for Feral druids, available at level 46. It increases the critical strike chance of your party/raid members by 5%. One must be in Cat Form or Bear Form for it to work. Because of this restriction, it's useful for druids that spend a lot of time as a tank or DD when they're in a party/raid.
Leafbeard Ring is a ring with agility, an improvement to hit rating, and an increase to attack power.

__NOTOC__ Lauriel Trueblade is a night elf ambassador of the Alliance, sent to Wyrmrest Temple to help the Wyrmrest Accord and through them, ingratiate the Alliance to the red dragonflight. She is later sent to the Twilight Highlands to establish relations with the local reds located at Vermillion Redoubt, but found them to be not nearly as accommodating. She thus meets up with the player after they've helped the Earthen Ring with Iso'rath to ask for assistance.
Lava Breath is one of the pet abilities that only core hounds can use. It slows the target's casting speed.

Leading the Cavalry is a collection achievement earned for learning how to summon 50 different mounts on a single character. Temporary items that let you ride a mount do not count towards this achievement. Upon completion, Mei Francis will mail you the Reins of the Albino Drake, a swift flying mount. With the pandaren mounts added to the factional mounts, the total normal mount count is up to 44, making this achievement much easier.
Leap is one of the abilities that is available to Unholy Death Knight Ghoul pets. It is affected by Dark Transformation.
Leaning Tower is a player vs. player achievement earned for destroying the 3 southern towers.

.]] Lava worms are gigantic worms from the Firelands. Like the gyreworms of Deepholm, these worms too are considered pests by the natives of the Firelands. While they are often seen within lava rivers or pools, they are capable of burrowing through the Firelands rock islands as well, bursting up at any location. Lava worms can also be found in Frostfire Ridge on .
Lava Beam is a shaman ability. It replaces Chain Lightning while using Ascendance as an Elemental shaman.
Leatei is a draenei dancer located at the World's End Tavern in Shattrath City.
__NOTOC__ Leara Moonsilk is a night elf leatherworking vendor found in Stormshield.
Layla Stonebreaker is a Highmountain tauren located at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar.
Leather-Lined Cage Helm drops from the Death Metal Knight during the Blight Boar concert every hour 30 minutes past the hour at the Darkmoon Faire.
Leaping Bugbots are mechanical spiders located on Mechagon Island.
Lava-Eater Mabutu is a pygmy who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Leaf on the Water is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Lavish Harvest is a conduit for shaman. It drops from the following bosses: *The Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).
Leaper is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Leaper.

Lava Fledglings are molten phoenixes found at the Burning Ascent in the Waking Shores. After killing them, they leave behind a Smoldering Feather that resurrects the phoenix into a Risen Phoenix if not destroyed.

The Leapin' Lizard is a Lizard used in the Blizzard Warcraft III 'Monolith'. Because of the power of the Monolith which has been attracting wildlife with its mysterious energies, it allows a Leapin' Lizard to gather gold and arrange rocks for lizard breeding. A Leapin' Lizard is the lowest level of lizard in Warcraft III costing One food and 50 gold and is classified as a worker. A Leapin' Lizard can arrange rocks for lizard breeding allowing it to provide ideal habitats for the breeding of lizards and Monolith Shards, becoming the Lizards only form of defensive structure. The appearance of Leapin' Lizard is like a skink a critter.

.]] Leatherworking is one of the primary professions. Your character can only have 2 primary professions at any time. The leatherworking profession allows players to utilize the leather gathered through the skinning profession to create a variety of items, including cloaks, leather and mail armor, and armor kits. The armor produced by leatherworking is chiefly of use to the leather and mail wearing classes: druid, hunter, shaman, monk, and rogue. While Leatherworking used to offer specializations at later levels, most recipes that used to require those can now be trained by all leatherworkers and many of the items made are now bind on equip.

Legendary quality is the second highest level of item quality available to players, above . It usually takes multiple end-game raid instance runs to acquire or craft these items. Legendary items are considered the most powerful items available to players. The names of legendary-quality items will appear in orange. There is also a higher category of items called that was introduced in Legion. For the list of legendary items, see Legendary items.

Left-Handed Claw can be purchased for from: * in Teldrassil * in Shattrath City * in Orgrimmar * in Dun Morogh

model.]] Leeni "Smiley" Smalls sells vintage Horde Mail and Plate PvP gear in Area 52 in the Netherstorm. In order to purchase from her you must have the appropriate Feat of Strength from the old PvP ranking system (eg: Legionnaire (Legacy); Knight-Captain (Legacy)).

Legends Volume 1 is the first part of a five-part manga graphic novel series. This book was republished in 2016 as a Blizzard Manga series. It contains numerous stories: Hot on the heels of the bestselling The Sunwell Trilogy series comes a stunning and truly awesome collection of original adventures set in the Warcraft universe.
Left-Handed Brass Knuckles can be purchased for from: * in Orgrimmar * in Teldrassil * in Shattrath City * in Dun Morogh

The Legerdemain Lounge is an inn and tavern located in the northern quarter of Runeweaver Square in Dalaran, with entrances facing both the Magus Commerce Exchange and Sunreaver's Sanctuary. The lounge consists of two floors, and a balcony overlooking the northern area of the city. It is staffed by Amisi Azuregaze as Innkeeper on the lower floor, Afsaneh Asrar, the assistant innkeeper on the upper floor, Arille Azuregaze and Mel Lynchen tending the bar, and Sandra Bartan as barmaid.
Leather Specialization is an ability gained by druids at level 50.
Legacy of the Emperor is a monk ability, learned at level 22.
Legacy of the White Tiger is a Brewmaster and Windwalker monk ability, available at level 81.
Leer of the Ox is a Brewmaster monk ability, learnt through selecting Glyph of Leer of the Ox.
Leech Seed is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Leech Life is an ability used by spiders, bats and shale spiders during a Pet Battle.

Legacy achievements are old achievements that are now deprecated, made obsolete due to changes in the game, and no longer attainable, but are still kept by those that achieved them when they were available. These include old Player vs. Player ranks, raids or dungeons that have been revamped such as Onyxia's Lair (Level 60), and removed Challenge Mode achievements, Challenge Conqueror: Gold for example. See Feats of Strength achievements for Feats that still might be obtainable.

__NOTOC__ Leech is a minor attribute introduced in Warlords of Draenor. Leech causes a player to instantly return health from both outgoing damage and outgoing heals. The amount of health returned is equal to your amount of Leech, 1% of Leech will return health equal to 1% of your damage and healing done. As an attribute, any Warlords-level or higher gear, looted or crafted, has a slight chance to be itemized with Leech. Additionally, Leech is present on certain class abilities, buffs, enchants, and temporary effects.
Draining the magic from the locket would leave behind a version that could be vendored.
Leg Strut XS drops from Mechanized Scraphounds and Upgraded Sentries and are contained in Scrap Piles on Mechagon Island.
Leeching Parasites are serpents of N'Zoth located in the Maw of Gor'ma in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Legendary Powers is sold by the Runeataur in Torghast, Tower of the Damned for .
Leather Apron is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Leeching Lilypad is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Legacy of the Sleeper is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Sleeper.
Legacy of the Frost Witch is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Frost Witch.

Leatherworking Designs are a reward from the following quests: *Basilisk Bucklers *Drums Here! *For Trisket, a Task Kit *Leatherworking Services Requested *Population Control *Soaked in Success *Tipping the Scales *To Fly a Kite *When You Give Bakar a Bone

Legacies is a series of animated shorts serving as a prelude to World of Warcraft: Dragonflight. Each episode focuses on the ancient past as Nozdormu delves into them to gain the keys to save an uncertain future. The series was announced on October 20, 2022, and the first episode premiered on October 25, 2022.

Lee Scolio is a Forsaken located in the Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades. He was wounded by the magic of the Scarlet Crusade when they attacked the home of the Forsaken. He later recuperated with the help of Calia Menethil and was present in the courtyard.
The Leggings of the Grand Crusader are powerful Paladin leggings.
Legguards of the Fallen Crusader are plate leggings that have a high amount of Strength, Agility, Stamina, and Intellect. They are very good for Paladins.
The Legguards of the Shattered Hand are a world drop from Outland mobs.

Legguards of Contemplation are a quest reward from Subdue the Subduer which begins with Illidari Lord Balthas in the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. To complete the quest, you must use the Soul Cannon to drain the life of Reth'hedron the Subduer.
The Legion Communication Device can be found in Legion Hold of Shadowmoon Valley.

Legion's Fate is an area in northern Kelp'thar Forest covered in sunken Horde vessels, most notably The Immortal Coil, where Horde players are taken to after being rescued from the attacking naga. To the east is Seafarer's Tomb, where the Alliance vessels now make their home.

Legion Strike is the starting ability of the Felguard warlock minion. It deals physical damage to all targets within 6 yards as well as applying a 10% healing debuff to the Felguard's current target for 6 seconds.
Legion Healthstone drops from demons and is found in Small Treasure Chests on Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.
The Legion Battlematrons can be found in the city of Suramar.

The Legion Invasion Simulator is a reputation reward; you must be with Armies of Legionfall to buy this item from at Deliverance Point at the Broken Shore in exchange for . Using it summons a Miniature Legion Command Ship with the following abilities: * * * *

Legion Assaults (or Demon Assaults) were launched in response to the invasion of the Broken Shore by the Armies of Legionfall, with the focus being on Azsuna, Highmountain, Stormheim, and Val'sharah. After repelling four invasion quests, adventurers work their way towards engaging the commander of the assault.
Legion Dreadwhisperers were shivarra summoned by Varimathras in the Royal Quarter during the Battle for the Undercity. They were fought by the Horde led by Warchief Thrall and Lady Sylvanas.
Legion Overlords were annihilan summoned by Varimathras in the Royal Quarter during the Battle for the Undercity. They were fought by the Horde led by Warchief Thrall and Lady Sylvanas.
Legion Invaders were wrathguard summoned by Varimathras in the Royal Quarter during the Battle for the Undercity. They were fought by the Horde led by Warchief Thrall and Lady Sylvanas.
Legion Banner is a device located in Despair Ridge at Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.
Legion Gateway Activators are devices that activate Burning Legion gateways, allowing troops to be quickly transported. Like most Legion constructs, they are powered by souls.
Legguards of Siphoned Power drop from Fallen Avatar in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Legion Codex Key would be used at Legion Hold in Shadowmoon Valley.
Legion Commander's Key would allow access to Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.

Leonid Barthalomew the Revered is an undead member of the Argent Crusade revered by his colleagues for the sacrifices he has made. He investigated the return of the powerful lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in the Eastern Plaguelands. Barthalomew looks at his undeath as a malady, an illness that merely requires treatment. However, he also considers it a great blessing for the Argent Dawn, believing that, as an undead, he is a great vessel to smite the abominations of the Scourge.
__NOTOC__ Lesser Eternal Essence is a magical essence of the Eternal plane used in enchanting. Three lesser eternal essences may be combined to form one Greater Eternal Essence.
__NOTOC__ Lesser Astral Essence is a magical essence of the Astral Plane.
Legplates of the Destroyer are excellent leggings for a dps classes.
The Lesser Arcanum of Resilience was a quest reward from Libram of Resilience (quest) obtained from Mathredis Firestar in the Burning Steppes.

:"So, you come from the world beyond the Portal? And you know of Rexxar." :"Oh yes, I am quite familiar with him. You see, he is my son." Leoroxx is the leader of the mok'nathal, a clan of ogre-orc hybrids dwelling in Blade's Edge Mountains, and the father of Rexxar, Champion of the Horde. The mok'nathal are very pacifistic, but Rexxar — against the wishes of his father — joined the Horde believing that there was nothing left for him among his people. For his actions, Leoroxx disowned him, and for thirty years his mind has remained stubbornly set against his son, even after Rexxar returned to Draenor — now Outland — to search for what remained of his people. Leoroxx has a companion lynx name
Lesser Belt of the Spire dropped from Blackrock Shadowcasters in Redridge Mountains prior to Cataclysm.
__NOTOC__ Lelagar is a blood elf blacksmithing vendor located at Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.
The Lesser Arcanum of Rumination can be obtained by completing the quest Libram of Rumination obtained from Mathredis Firestar in the Burning Steppes.
Legplates of the Eternal Guardian is a pair of Level 51 quality Plate Legguards that improve Strength, Stamina and Dodge.
Leona Tharpe is a Forsaken found in the War Quarter in the Undercity. She speaks with Joanna Whitehall and Gerard Abernathy about the human mindslave Theresa.
__NOTOC__ Lenedil Moonwing is a night elf general goods vendor located at the Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.
Lena Stonebrush is a representative of the Lorewalkers sent to the Shrine of Two Moons to enlist Horde aid. She can be found on the lower level of the Golden Terrace.
Lens Flare is an ability used by Rascal-Bot during a Pet Battle.
Lesser Contaminated Puddles are oozelings found at the Pools of Power of Siege of Orgrimmar.

Leorajh is a saberon found in the Spires of Arak. He was once part of the Bloodmane tribe, but was banished for being smaller and weaker than the others. Leorajh later found the cave, in which adventurers find him in, along with a sunstone that taught him many things. He had also found the Apexis Chamber and its artifacts. The crystals there had made him calmer, and he took up the current name. The chamber was also found by Sol-Shaper Valarik who planned to dispose of the saberon. Saving him from the arakkoa will make him want to join the hero's "clan". The path up the mountain starts near Leorajh's Den. He can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highm

The Legion of Torment were led by Nera'thor, who served under the Mistress of Torment. The Legion of Torment was tasked with protecting and securing Magtheridon's Black Temple against any enemy who would attack the Lord of Outland. When the Illidari invaded in order to remove the pit lord from power, the Legion of Torment was defeated with both Nera'thor and their mistress killed. It is assumed that any surviving fel orcs eventually joined the Fel Horde under Warchief Kargath Bladefist.

The Legion of Anguish were led by Sagra'nel, who served under the Mistress of Torment. Leystone is a metal found throughout the Broken Isles. It's light like mithril, easy to shape, and has a magical energy more potent than even saronite or elementium. It reacts violently with certain substances, as if they were a contaminant. Using foreign-mined welding flux on leystone can have explosive results. This problem can be worked around by making flux from local ingredients that have adapted to coexist with leystone, such as :foxflower; or by crafting leystone armor out of a single piece, as the Hatecoil naga have done.

.]] Life Tap was a level 34 warlock spell that converted health into mana. It is no longer in the game. Life Tap epitomizes the character of the warlock, sacrificing a chunk of their own life in exchange for a rapid injection of power. This tradeoff can allow warlocks to produce an endless stream of damage and death - while their health holds.

Light's Hope Chapel is the Argent Crusade base of operations in the Eastern Plaguelands, and a place of comfort for those who make the journey here. Located on the slopes of a mountainous area east of the region, it serves as a quest hub for both Horde and Alliance heroes. Originally a mere chapel, it expanded into a full-fledged fortified outpost after the end of the Scourgewar. Underneath the chapel is a catacomb which houses the remains of the heroes of Lordaeron. Many of the remains were exhumed from around Lordaeron and moved to the chapel so they could not be resurrected in the service of the Lich King.

Lifegiving Seed turns the character into a random herb model in a 'stunned' state (cannot use any abilities). It also changes the character's name to "Peacebloom" (no matter what herb beside Peacebloom the character appears as). The character remains targetable and displays their nameplate. In order to cancel the effect, the player must right-click off the "Herbouflage" buff on their character's unit frame.
